modules.name: minisvc.cli
modules.purpose: CLI bootstrap: loads settings, creates the repository, initializes the schema, and reports readiness.

modules.name: minisvc.config
modules.purpose: Defines immutable Settings and reads MINISVC_DB and MINISVC_READONLY from the environment.

modules.name: minisvc.api.routes
modules.purpose: Registers POST and GET order handlers on an app adapter.

modules.name: minisvc.api.handlers
modules.purpose: Builds order use cases for create and read requests.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.repo
modules.purpose: Persists and retrieves orders in SQLite.

modules.name: minisvc.audit
modules.purpose: Builds in-memory order event dictionaries; it does not persist them.

modules.name: minisvc.__init__
modules.purpose: Package marker/metadata only; not business logic.

modules.name: minisvc.api.__init__
modules.purpose: Empty package marker; not business logic.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.__init__
modules.purpose: Empty package marker; not business logic.

key_functions.description: Loads environment settings, constructs OrderRepository, calls init_schema, prints readiness, returns 0.
Maps MINISVC_DB (default orders.sqlite) and MINISVC_READONLY (true only for "1") to Settings.
Binds POST /orders and GET /orders/<order_id> lambdas to handlers.
Indexes order_id/customer/total_cents, casts total_cents to int, saves an Order, and returns a response event.
Reads by ID and returns missing or ok response plus a read event for found orders.
Creates the orders table if absent.
Performs one SQLite insert; no retry or error mapping.
Selects one order and rebuilds Order from the row.
Returns an in-memory event dict; no database or file write occurs.

runtime_flows.name: CLI startup
steps: readiness message is printed and 0 is returned

runtime_flows.name: HTTP create-order
steps: handler reads payload fields and constructs Order
repo.save(order) opens SQLite and inserts into orders
handler returns status created, order_id, and event
